description: Created By Shane BlackbuRn. Time-zone rule for place.timezone in sync format v1: the name must be a real IANA time zone in the checker's own time-zone database (Java: java.time.ZoneId.getAvailableZoneIds(); Python: zoneinfo with the tzdata package), excluding the names below so every checker gives the same answer. Wrong characters are BAD_FORMAT; a well-formed unknown name (such as auto, UTC+13 or Not/ARealZone) is BAD_VALUE. Kotlin keeps the same list in TimeZones (SyncFormat.kt); a test keeps them identical.
